title: Free PC | A focused laptop for students
excerpt: A 14-inch student laptop with an AI-Free operating system designed to block AI tools, social media, news, and entertainment.
content_html:
Built for focused homework

A laptop that keeps homework human.

AI-Free PC is a 14-inch student laptop with an AI-Free operating system. It is designed to block AI, social media, news, and entertainment so your child has a quiet place to focus and do homework without the assistance of AI.

14-inch laptop

AI-Free OS

8GB RAM

256GB SSD

School choice funds accepted

Use your ESA or CHOOSE Act funds to purchase AI-Free PC

AI-Free PC is an approved ClassWallet DirectPay vendor for Arizona ESA and Alabama CHOOSE Act families. Download an invoice from us, then submit it through ClassWallet's Pay Vendor feature.

How to buy with ClassWallet

Homework done by your child, not AI

Our operating system is designed to keep AI assistants out of the workflow, so students have to read, think, write, and solve themselves.

Distractions removed

AI, social media, news, and entertainment are blocked so AI-Free PC opens into study mode, not distraction mode.

Curated, study-focused internet

A firewall is built into our operating system that only allows your child to access a curated list of study-focused websites.

The AI-induced crisis

AI is teaching students to skip the work that teaches them how to think.

Students now use AI to write papers, solve math problems, summarize books, and more. Your child will forget how to think if he/she is not doing the homework.

The results are catastrophic

When AI does the homework, your child's grades suffer and confidence drops.

Early studies indicate that children's average test scores drop after using AI to do their work for them. Furthermore, students lose confidence in their ability to solve problems without AI assistance, creating an unhealthy dependency on AI.

Bastani et al., PNAS, 2025

Test scores dropped 17%

In a field experiment with nearly 1,000 high-school math students, regular GPT-4-style access improved practice scores by 48%, then students scored 17% worse when they had to take the test without AI.

Education and Information Technologies, 2025

Loss of self-confidence

A 2025 study of 326 university students found academic generative AI use was tied to lower academic self-efficacy, lower academic performance, and higher learned helplessness.

Microsoft Research / CHI, 2025

Loss of critical-thinking

A Microsoft and Carnegie Mellon study found that when people trusted generative AI more, they reported less critical thinking effort on AI-assisted tasks.

Fight back with AI-Free PC

Protect your child's mind with AI-Free PC.

Reclaim your child's learning. AI-Free PC arms students with essential, curated study tools while actively shutting out the AI cheat machines, endless social feeds, and digital traps that steal their focus.

The approved list

Our firewall only allows approved study and homework websites.

AI-Free PC uses an approved whitelist of websites. If a website is not on that list, our built-in firewall blocks it. The examples shown here are some of the approved websites students can access for research, homeschooling, grammar, and study.
